query: What are the worst health disparity zones in Missouri based on uninsured rates?
answer_preview: Missouri's Rural Health Disparity Hotspots. Rural counties in Northern and Central Missouri face the most significant health disparities, driven by uninsured rates exceeding 30% in the most extreme cases. Top 3: Scotland County (31.1%), Knox County (25.3%), Morgan County (24.1%)
